result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a misspelled search placeholder, a truncated restaurant name in the horizontal carousel, and bottom content clipped by the navigation bar.

issues.description: Search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' - 'Restaurants' is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' cut off mid-word at the screen edge without ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal list end-padding and apply proper text truncation with ellipsis so full name is accessible on scroll

issues.description: Second card in 'Popular right now' (pizza with -20% badge) is clipped behind the bottom tab bar, hiding restaurant name, rating and delivery info.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding / safe-area inset so scrollable content ends above the bottom navigation
